payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in neural machine translation (NMT) systems, particularly for low-resourced language pairs like Japanese-Vietnamese.

claims.text: Data augmentation methods, including back-translation and mix-source techniques, were used to increase the amount of training data.
A variant of the Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) algorithm was proposed to perform effective word segmentation for Vietnamese texts, addressing the rare-word problem.
Segmenting words into subword units allows NMT to learn translations with fewer data by breaking down compound words into their components.
